message.content: Jennifer Moore offers several tips for managing muscle soreness after workouts. She suggests staying hydrated, engaging in light activities like gentle yoga or walking to aid recovery, spending time stretching post-workout to improve flexibility and relieve tension, using a foam roller on sore spots to help with muscle tightness, and ensuring adequate rest. Additionally, she recommends following these tips to alleviate the discomfort: "Drink plenty of water. Staying hydrated helps with recovery. Engage in light activities like walking or gentle yoga. It can help alleviate soreness. Spend some time stretching your muscles post-workout to improve flexibility and relieve tension. Use a foam roller on sore spots. It can really help with muscle tightness. Don't skip on recovery days. Your muscles need time to heal!"
